admission_rule: Admit an implementation candidate only when the same concrete non-nominal architectural cost is material in at least three unlike verifier-backed applications and a causal mechanism has not already failed broad guards.

boundaries.boundary: generated runtime helpers and boxed/dynamic fallback
boundaries.breadth: 35 selected applications counted; 32 completed generated-Go diagnostics
boundaries.exact_result: Boxed binary, boxed unary, generic interface dispatch, checked generic Array indexing, String conversion, and generic-union fallback executed zero times. The only broad new helper, integer conversion, was below 1% flat in three unlike profiles and absent in a fourth.
boundaries.reference_comparison: Current hot compiled paths execute direct generated Go bodies rather than a shared boxed interpreter/runtime envelope.

boundaries.boundary: escape, nullable scalar, and small nominal/union result representation
boundaries.breadth: broad static emission; exact dynamic attribution in text, graph, and regex applications
boundaries.exact_result: Static escape breadth collapses dynamically to one nullable primitive consumer and one material nominal definition, Utf8DecodeResult. Required allocation owners otherwise divide among nodes, arrays, maps, regex values, and application results.
boundaries.reference_comparison: Go escape analysis already removes broad emitted shapes when their identity does not escape; the remaining material values do not share one structural lifetime across unlike applications.

boundaries.boundary: runtime package reachability, process initialization, and execution-context publication
boundaries.breadth: selected compiled launchers plus concurrency, N-Body, Binary Trees, and text/map guards
boundaries.exact_result: Removing unused interpreter/runtime roots materially reduced binaries and startup, while fixed-context and package-boundary variants exchanged wins for regressions in Binary Trees, N-Body, or K-Nucleotide. Concurrency currentGID remains exact and broad but its replacement failed the unlike guard.
boundaries.reference_comparison: The residual startup/context work is not a universal generated-main tax: its material descendants are scheduler identity, package publication, GC pacing, or absent roots depending on the application.

boundaries.boundary: runResumable primary opcode dispatch and instruction layout
boundaries.breadth: material flat dispatcher cost across at least six unlike applications
boundaries.exact_result: The dispatcher is a real shared architectural wall, but a direct opcode, layout-stabilized existing-opcode design, typed loop-block executor, restricted register IR, and cross-suite Go PGO either regressed unlike applications, lacked dynamic reach, or created an undeployable plugin/profile dependency.
boundaries.reference_comparison: References execute comparable source operations through their mature native interpreter/runtime paths; Able's residual dispatch cannot be removed by merely rearranging the current Go switch or adding a second dispatcher.

boundaries.boundary: raw integer/float extraction, normalization, boxing, and slot/stack transport
boundaries.breadth: raw integer CPU recurrence across text, iterator, numeric, and wide workloads; normalized raw-float allocation across three unlike numeric applications
boundaries.exact_result: The exact leaves are broad and material, but unified extraction beats hot/cold splitting, integer carrier and sidecar changes regress guards, and raw-float lane/carrier variants cut allocations while regressing wall time by 12.7%-23.6%.
boundaries.reference_comparison: Able's general Value contract pays representation transitions that reference runtimes often keep inside specialized native loops, but the tested general carrier alternatives add more Go-side work than they remove.

boundaries.boundary: call lookup/dispatch, inline frame construction, return restoration, and coercion
boundaries.breadth: call/return parents recur across text, iterator, numeric, map, regex, and control workloads
boundaries.exact_result: Concrete descendants divide by native/direct/member/Array/static call route and by return coercion. The only shared frame ABI candidate, a caller-owned result structure, regressed three unlike workloads; raw-cell preservation and return-guard reorder were neutral or regressive.
boundaries.reference_comparison: The VM must preserve Able exceptions, loop signals, scheduler yields, dynamic resolution, and coercion at this boundary; no single redundant step repeats materially beneath that contract across three unlike current profiles.

boundaries.boundary: fresh positional nominal construction and returned value lifetime
boundaries.breadth: allocator material in four applications; returned-shape selection extended across JSON, Document Audit, and Reverse Complement
boundaries.exact_result: The four-program allocator aggregate splits into Utf8DecodeResult in two text consumers and RegexNFAThread in two related regex consumers. Values cross returns, calls, collections, mutation, or identity boundaries; no hot definition/lifetime repeats in three unlike applications.
boundaries.reference_comparison: Scalar replacement or pooling would change observable nominal identity/alias behavior unless a static non-escape proof exists; the current corpus does not supply that proof broadly.

boundaries.boundary: Go map access, malloc/GC, and broad collection parents
boundaries.breadth: aggregate symbols recur across text/map, iterator, numeric, regex, and output profiles
boundaries.exact_result: Caller attribution separates environment bindings, type/member caches, Able HashMap operations, String parsing, required result growth, nominal construction, and host conversion. The retained generic HashMap index removed the one shared linear search; residual leaves have different semantic owners.
boundaries.reference_comparison: Go runtime aggregation symbols are implementation envelopes rather than one Able operation, so their recurrence alone cannot justify a compiler, VM, or stdlib rule.

decision.reason: No untested concrete architecture boundary satisfies both the three-unlike-application materiality rule and the broad causal-wall requirement. The current frontier remains zero-actionable.
decision.required_invalidation: A new portable real-world application family, changed language/runtime semantics, or new exact evidence must expose a concrete shared child not covered by the recorded retained/rejected mechanisms.
